assets.name: style
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished art direction approval board for THE LAST ROUTE, a professional dark urban survival 2D pixel art game. Wide landscape board. Main large panel: genuine crisp pixel art, 3/4 overhead camera (not isometric diamond), side-progressing abandoned commercial street at night, wet asphalt, broken Local 24 shopfront, litter, graffiti, dim cyan neon, warm street lamps, rain, parked derelict car, overgrown pavement. Small recognizable courier Nico: dark jacket, orange delivery backpack, dark hair, visible knife, discrete cyan reflective strips. One gaunt urban zombie in torn gray-green clothes. Secondary panels: enlarged pixel Nico front/side/back views, zombie silhouette, three pixel dialogue expressions of Nico and cold corporate boss on a phone transmission. Palette swatches night blue #111A2B, charcoal #252832, purple #34253F, cyan #5E9B9B, warm orange #D68A49, danger red #A63845. Include clearly legible title THE LAST ROUTE and label VISUAL DIRECTION 01. Mature restrained pixel craft, strong silhouette, hand-placed looking square pixel clusters, no smoothing, no vector primitives, no blurry pixel filters. This is an art direction board not a claim of complete production animations. Beautiful editorial layout on dark charcoal.

Idle breathing cycle six frames, subtle torso rise, backpack settles, alert stance.
